title: Corrigibility as a Singular Target: A Vision for Inherently Reliable Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper proposes a novel alignment framework (CAST) focused on corrigibility and includes an extensive appendix (Appendix A) featuring over 20 detailed scenarios that evaluate and define the ethical and moral behavior of AI agents when faced with dilemmas, value conflicts, and human directives (e.g., instructions to harm animals or commit illegal acts).
